evidence.evidence_text: We introduce PRISM, a highly token-efficient in-context method based on structured schemas that outperforms baselines on diverse tasks with 4x shorter contexts.
We introduce PRISM, a highly token-efficient in-context method based on structured schemas that outperforms baselines on diverse tasks with 4x shorter contexts.
This approach produces concise outputs and efficiently leverages key-value (KV) caches to reduce costs by up to 54%.
